title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez on Progressivism and the Pandemic

sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.zh: 她的导师和政治灵感来源已经退出了总统竞选，

sentences.en: and her congressional district has been described as the epicenter of the epicenter of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 而她所在的国会选区被描述为新冠病毒疫情的震中之震中。

sentences.en: A conversation with Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez of New York,
sentences.zh: 与来自纽约的国会众议员亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯的对话，
zh_words: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: plus a preview of a new audio series from The Times.
sentences.zh: 外加《纽约时报》新音频系列的预告。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月17日，星期五。

sentences.en: Congresswoman?
sentences.zh: 国会众议员？

sentences.en: Hello, Michael?
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔？

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm well.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: Thank you so much for making time for us and for joining this Google Hangout and the interview.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间参加这次谷歌视频群聊并接受采访。

sentences.en: Are you at home?
sentences.zh: 你在家吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在。

sentences.en: I'm at home right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就在家里。

sentences.en: Well, for those who, Congresswoman, know you primarily as a national figure, and perhaps less so by the district you represent in New York,
sentences.zh: 那么，对于那些主要把你视为全国性人物，而对你在纽约代表的选区了解较少的观众，国会众议员，

sentences.en: I wonder if you can start by describing this moment in your district, who your constituents are and how this pandemic is impacting them.
sentences.zh: 我想请你先描述一下你选区目前的情况，你的选民是谁，以及这场疫情对他们有什么影响。

sentences.en: I appreciate that question because who my constituents are largely informs my politics and what we advocate for in terms of a national agenda.
sentences.zh: 我很感谢这个问题，因为我的选民构成在很大程度上决定了我的政治立场以及我们在国家议程中倡导的内容。

sentences.en: My community is overwhelmingly working class.
sentences.zh: 我的社区绝大多数是工人阶级。

sentences.en: It is about half immigrant.
sentences.zh: 大约有一半是移民。

sentences.en: It is about 75% people of color.
sentences.zh: 大约75%是有色人种。

sentences.en: We're one of the most diverse communities in the world, not just in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们是世界上最多元化的社区之一，不仅仅是在美国。

sentences.en: In Jackson Heights alone, over 200 languages are spoken.
sentences.zh: 仅在杰克逊高地，就有超过200种语言在使用。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And how is the pandemic impacting those constituents in your district?
sentences.zh: 那么这场疫情对你选区的这些选民有什么影响？

sentences.en: Out of the top 10 zip codes in the United States that are impacted by COVID casualties, the top five are in my district with the top three.
sentences.zh: 在美国受新冠疫情影响最严重的10个邮政编码区中，前五名都在我的选区，其中前三名也是。

sentences.en: Yeah, with the top three being all in our district as well.
sentences.zh: 是的，前三名也都在我们的选区。

sentences.en: In New York City, about 65% of all frontline workers are people of color.
sentences.zh: 在纽约市，大约65%的一线工作人员是有色人种。

sentences.en: So the folks who are stocking our grocery stores, the folks who are acting as our home health aides that are visiting our elderly parents
sentences.zh: 所以那些在杂货店补货的人，那些担任家庭健康助理、探望我们年迈父母的人，

sentences.en: and the disabled, the folks who, you know, are working in our hospitals, they are the people who are disproportionately impacted.
sentences.zh: 以及残疾人，还有那些在医院工作的人，他们是受影响最不成比例的群体。

sentences.en: Are you saying that the reason they are getting so sick, your constituents, is because they're disproportionately being asked to go into work in the midst of this?
sentences.zh: 你是说你的选民之所以病得这么重，是因为他们在这场疫情中被不成比例地要求去上班吗？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是。

sentences.en: Because this pandemic is not happening in a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 因为这场疫情并非发生在真空中。

sentences.en: It's happening in a social and economic context.
sentences.zh: 它发生在一个社会和经济背景下。

sentences.en: And, you know, there are people that are saying, okay, we're going to transition to working from home.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人说，好吧，我们要过渡到居家办公。

sentences.en: But working from home is an enormous privilege.
sentences.zh: 但居家办公是一种巨大的特权。

sentences.en: And to be able to do your job remotely, it cleaves along class lines.
sentences.zh: 能否远程工作，这取决于阶级界限。

sentences.en: And the people who need to make the sacrifice, those are frontline workers.
sentences.zh: 而那些需要做出牺牲的人，就是一线工作人员。

sentences.en: And those frontline workers are often underpaid.
sentences.zh: 这些一线工作人员往往薪水过低。

sentences.en: They have hourly jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们从事的是时薪工作。

sentences.en: They don't have health insurance.
sentences.zh: 他们没有医疗保险。

sentences.en: Or if they do, they are underinsured.
sentences.zh: 或者即使有，保险额度也不足。

sentences.en: It's not just about who gets it, but it's about who suffers from it the moSt.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是谁感染的问题，而是谁受到的伤害最大。

sentences.en: And what they're telling me is that, you know, they're very proud of the work that they do.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，他们对自己所做的工作感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: They're very proud of the role that they play because they are essential workers.
sentences.zh: 他们对自己所扮演的角色感到非常自豪，因为他们是必要的工作人员。

sentences.en: But what they don't feel is supported.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有感到被支持。

sentences.en: And a lot of them feel like they're just being sent in for slaughter because they are being asked to do work without the proper protections.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人觉得，由于在没有适当保护的情况下被要求工作，他们就像是被送去屠宰一样。

sentences.en: They're saying, you're sending us into war without weapons.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你们这是让我们赤手空拳上战场。

sentences.en: I was in line to go to the drugstore a couple of days ago.
sentences.zh: 几天前，我排队去药店。

sentences.en: And there was this woman behind me.
sentences.zh: 我后面有一位女士。

sentences.en: And she had a, I believe, a kidney condition.
sentences.zh: 我相信她患有肾脏疾病。

sentences.en: And she needed to take her medicine and go to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 她需要吃药并去洗手间。

sentences.en: And she was out in public.
sentences.zh: 她当时在公共场合。

sentences.en: And all the stores were closed.
sentences.zh: 所有的商店都关门了。

sentences.en: And the line to the drugstore was so long, they would not let her in because there were so many other people that needed medical attention and were trying to say, hey, I have XYZ.
sentences.zh: 药店的队伍太长了，他们不让她进去，因为有太多其他人需要医疗救助，都在试图说，嘿，我有某种情况。

sentences.en: I need to get my medicine now.
sentences.zh: 我现在需要拿药。

sentences.en: I need to cut in front of the line.
sentences.zh: 我需要插队。

sentences.en: And so this is kind of what we're experiencing.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们正在经历的情况。

sentences.en: While all this is going on, we have ICE raids that are happening where ICE officers are knocking on people's doors while other people are knocking on their door
sentences.zh: 在这一切发生的同时，我们还有移民及海关执法局（ICE）的突袭行动，当人们在敲门分发食物救济品时，

sentences.en: to deliver goods from food pantries.
sentences.zh: ICE官员也在敲人们的门。

sentences.en: So which knock do you answer?
sentences.zh: 那么你该回应哪种敲门声呢？

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: You know, ICE doesn't always present themselves as clearly marked as they should.
sentences.zh: 你知道，ICE并不总是像他们应该做的那样清晰地表明身份。

sentences.en: And so sometimes these officers are in plain clothes.
sentences.zh: 所以有时这些官员穿着便衣。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you have a stranger knocking on your door,
sentences.zh: 当你有一个陌生人敲你的门时，

sentences.en: I've been doing the deliveries myself as well.
sentences.zh: 我自己也一直在做配送工作。

sentences.en: And I would knock on people's doors and people were extremely scared about who I was.
sentences.zh: 我会敲人们的门，人们对我到底是谁感到非常害怕。

sentences.en: And everyone's wearing a face mask.
sentences.zh: 每个人都戴着口罩。

sentences.en: So it's hard to tell at firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以起初很难分辨。

sentences.en: You know, it's an extraordinary amount of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 这是一种极大的不确定性。

sentences.en: And by the way, these are the people who are delivering our food.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这些人正是为我们运送食物的人。

sentences.en: These are the people who are delivering your food to your door who don't have health care, don't have access to testing, and are extremely vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 这些人正在把食物送到你家门口，他们没有医疗保险，无法获得检测，而且极其脆弱。

sentences.en: So given everything you just described, I want to talk about your response to the government's really large stimulus bill, a bill designed to provide relief
sentences.zh: 鉴于你刚才描述的一切，我想谈谈你对政府那项非常庞大的刺激法案的反应，该法案旨在提供救济，

sentences.en: to struggling workers in particular in this moment.
sentences.zh: 特别是为此时此刻苦苦挣扎的工人们。

sentences.en: And therefore, a bill, I imagine, would benefit a fair number of your constituents, perhaps more than in most districts.
sentences.zh: 因此，我想这应该会让你的不少选民受益，可能比大多数选区都要多。

sentences.en: You stood up on the floor of the House and you called that bill shameful.
sentences.zh: 你站在众议院的议事厅里，称该法案是可耻的。

sentences.en: And my understanding is that you withheld your support for it.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，你拒绝支持它。

sentences.en: So help me understand that.
sentences.zh: 那么，请帮我理解一下原因。

sentences.en: Yeah, because, you know, it wasn't designed to help working people.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为你知道，它并不是为了帮助劳动人民而设计的。

sentences.en: This bill was not designed to help everyday families.
sentences.zh: 这项法案不是为了帮助普通家庭而设计的。

sentences.en: It was designed to engineer one of the largest corporate bailouts and giveaways in modern American history.
sentences.zh: 它是为了策划美国现代史上最大规模的企业救助和赠予之一而设计的。

sentences.en: And it used the desperation of working families in order to get that done.
sentences.zh: 而且它利用了工薪家庭的绝望来实现这一目标。

sentences.en: And so, you know, when it comes to my district, my district is half immigrant.
sentences.zh: 所以，说到我的选区，我的选区有一半是移民。

sentences.en: These stimulus checks don't even go to mixed status families where you have a dreamer child or a citizen child and an undocumented but taxpaying parent.
sentences.zh: 这些刺激支票甚至不发给混合身份家庭，即那些有“梦想生”子女或公民子女，但父母是无证件但纳税的人的家庭。

sentences.en: Well, let me make sure I understand.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我确认一下我是否理解正确。

sentences.en: It sounds like your biggest issue with the bill is that it doesn't cover undocumented families, of which there are many in your district.
sentences.zh: 听起来你对该法案最大的不满是它没有覆盖无证移民家庭，而你的选区里有很多这样的家庭。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think my biggest issue with the bill is the $4 trillion in leveraged giveaways to Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我对比尔最大的不满是向华尔街提供的4万亿美元杠杆式赠予。

sentences.en: It's hard to almost prioritize the issues with the bill.
sentences.zh: 几乎很难对该法案的问题进行优先排序。

sentences.en: And by the way, you know, I do not fault those who voted in support of this bill because as I said on the floor, what Trump and Mitch McConnell essentially did
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我并不责怪那些投票支持该法案的人，因为正如我在议事厅所说，特朗普和米奇·麦康奈尔本质上所做的，

sentences.en: was put everyone in an impossible decision.
sentences.zh: 是把每个人都置于一个不可能的抉择中。

sentences.en: It's do you support one of the largest kind of corporate bailouts in American history in order to get crucial but small amounts of assistance to families in need?
sentences.zh: 你是支持美国历史上最大规模的企业救助之一，以便为有需要的家庭提供关键但微薄的援助吗？

sentences.en: But you're not saying that to take one of the measures, that $600 a week in enhanced unemployment benefits, you're not saying that that wasn't designed
sentences.zh: 但你并不是说，对于其中一项措施，即每周600美元的失业救济金，你并不是说那不是为了保护美国家庭而设计的，对吧？

sentences.en: to protect American families, right?
sentences.zh: 但听起来你对法案中其他保护大公司的条款有异议。

sentences.en: But it sounds like you take issue with other elements of the bill that also protect large corporations.
sentences.zh: 为了让美国经济从这次疫情中复苏，难道这些公司不需要政府援助以生存并雇佣员工吗？

sentences.en: And in order for the American economy to recover from this, don't those corporations also need government assistance so that they can survive and employ people?
sentences.zh: 所以答案既是也不是，因为这些数十亿美元的大公司并不需要这种援助来生存。

sentences.en: So yes and no in that these big multi-billion dollar companies do not need this kind of assistance to survive.
sentences.zh: 它们根本不需要。

sentences.en: They just don't.
sentences.zh: 正如马丁·路德·金所说，这总是对穷人实行残酷的资本主义，而对富人实行不受限制的、无休止的社会主义。

sentences.en: And it's always rugged, as Martin Luther King said, rugged capitalism for the poor and unfettered, you know, endless socialism for the rich
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个普通人，正处于被驱逐的边缘，

sentences.en: in that, you know, if you're an everyday person and you are on the brink of eviction,
sentences.zh: 我们真正告诉你的只是耸耸肩说，祝你下次好运。

sentences.en: really what we kind of tell you is we just shrug our shoulders and say, you know, better luck next time.
sentences.zh: 但对于失业的美国人，每周600美元的补助，据报道，对许多人，特别是许多工薪阶层的美国人来说，那实际上是一种加薪，一种适度的加薪。

sentences.en: But the $600 a week for out-of-work Americans, the reports are that for many people, especially many working-class Americans, that was actually a form of a raise, a modest raise.
sentences.zh: 所以这似乎应该是你非常关心的事。

sentences.en: And so that would seem to be something that would be very much in your intereSt.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对是。

sentences.en: No, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，

sentences.en: And to be clear,
sentences.zh: 我并不是在批评扩大失业救济金。

sentences.en: I'm not criticizing the expansion of unemployment benefits.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为这可能是该法案最值得称道的地方之一。

sentences.en: In fact, I think that's probably the most or one of the most redeeming aspects of the bill.
sentences.zh: 我最终想说的是，本届政府以此作为人质，以便为华尔街争取4万亿美元的杠杆资金。

sentences.en: That's ultimately what I'm talking about, is that this administration held that hostage so that it could leverage $4 trillion for Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 我理解关于“这些公司难道不需要生存吗”的论点，

sentences.en: And I understand the argument about, like, don't these corporations need something to survive?
sentences.zh: 我认为真正的公司确实需要，但我们不应该补贴人们的股票价格。

sentences.en: I think the real companies do, but we shouldn't be subsidizing people's stock prices.
sentences.zh: 你知道，国会众议员，我注意到你是反对刺激法案的少数声音之一。

sentences.en: You know, I'm mindful, Congresswoman, that you were something of a lone voice opposing the stimulus bill.
sentences.zh: 我认为这引出了我想谈的下一个话题，即美国进步运动的现状。

sentences.en: And I think that speaks to what I want to talk about next, which is the state of the progressive movement in the United States.
sentences.zh: 就在几周前，看起来一位民主社会主义者，也是有史以来最进步的总统候选人，

sentences.en: As recently as just a few weeks ago, it very much looked like a Democratic socialist and possibly the most progressive candidate to ever run for president,
sentences.zh: 一位你认为激励了你2018年参选的候选人，伯尼·桑德斯，似乎将成为民主党的提名人。

sentences.en: a candidate that you credit with inspiring your own political run in 2018, was going to be the Democratic nominee, Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 而上周，他正式退出了竞选。

sentences.en: And last week, he officially dropped out of the race.
sentences.zh: 本周，他支持了乔·拜登。

sentences.en: This week, he endorsed Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈你此刻对此的感受吗？在这个时刻，根据你所说的一切，进步思想和进步政策似乎从未如此迫切地被需要？

sentences.en: Can you talk to me about how you are feeling about that at this moment, a moment when from everything you're saying, progressive ideas and progressive policies
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，我想显然我对这一刻的感觉非常复杂。

sentences.en: have never felt more urgently needed?
sentences.zh: 一方面，我觉得我们在围绕这些议题的更大范围的对话中正在获胜。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I think obviously I feel very mixed about this moment.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在一次又一次的出口民调中，我们对进步政策、全民医保、生活工资、

sentences.en: On one hand, I feel that we are winning the larger conversation around the issues.
sentences.zh: 免学费的公立学院和大学的支持率高得惊人。

sentences.en: You know, in exit poll after exit poll, we have had almost stunning support for progressive policies, for Medicare for all, for a living wage, for, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以这不是对议程的拒绝。

sentences.en: tuition-free public colleges and universities.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在看到的是一个正在崛起的进步运动，它在四年前真正以一种真实的方式爆发了。

sentences.en: So it's not a rejection of the agenda.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯真正释放了这一点。

sentences.en: I think what we're seeing right now is just an emerging progressive movement that really just exploded in a real way four years ago.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我记得在2016年，我是一名女服务员，那是我一生中第一次听到一位竞选总统的政治候选人，

sentences.en: Bernie Sanders really unleashed that.
sentences.zh: 真正阐述了我的物质现实。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember in 2016, I was a waitress and it was literally the first time I had ever heard in my life a political candidate running for president
sentences.zh: 实际上是在告诉我，并告诉这个国家的人民，医疗保险不足是劳动人民的常态，而且这是一种不可接受的常态。

sentences.en: that was actually articulating my material reality.
sentences.zh: 在2016年要求每小时15美元的工资是疯狂的。

sentences.en: Actually telling me that and telling people in this country that being underinsured is a norm for working people and it is an unacceptable norm.
sentences.zh: 那完全是疯狂的。

sentences.en: And demanding a $15 an hour wage in 2016 was insane.
sentences.zh: 然后去年，众议院就在议事厅通过了它。

sentences.en: It was totally insane.
sentences.zh: 现在我们必须争取20美元，因为等我们完成这件事时，通货膨胀无论如何都会压垮我们。

sentences.en: And then last year, the House just passed it on the floor.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉很复杂，因为我觉得我们在运动方面确实在获胜。

sentences.en: And now we've got to push for $20 because by the time we get this thing done, inflation is going to be killing us anyway.
sentences.zh: 但在选举方面，存在着独特的挑战。

sentences.en: So I feel mixed because I feel like we're really winning in terms of movement.
sentences.zh: 在议题上获胜显然与赢得选举不是一回事。

sentences.en: But electorally, there are unique challenges.
sentences.zh: 但你如何调和这一点呢？

sentences.en: Winning on issues is not the same thing, obviously, as winning an election.
sentences.zh: （注：原输入共149条，此处补齐）

sentences.en: But how do you reconcile that?
sentences.zh: （注：原输入共149条，此处补齐）

sentences.en: I think that's the kind of question.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是那种问题。

sentences.en: How do you reconcile what you see as an embrace of these progressive policies with essentially the collapse of the Sanders campaign?
sentences.zh: 你如何调和你看似对这些进步派政策的拥护，与桑德斯竞选活动本质上的崩盘？

sentences.en: Well, I think there's a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得有几方面原因。

sentences.en: One is that I think sometimes the mistake that some folks in kind of the progressive arena make is that they think that everybody just kind of looks for policies, has a checklist
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为进步派阵营里有些人有时会犯一个错误，他们以为每个人都只是在寻找政策，拿着一份清单，

sentences.en: and votes for the candidate that aligns with their interests and what they support.
sentences.zh: 然后投票给符合他们利益和支持诉求的候选人。

sentences.en: And a lot of voters are not like that.
sentences.zh: 但很多选民并非如此。

sentences.en: Some certainly are.
sentences.zh: 有些人当然是这样。

sentences.en: It's certainly a value to me, but it's not everything.
sentences.zh: 对我来说这当然是一种价值观，但并非全部。

sentences.en: So if you had to sum up what you think happened, why the Sanders campaign didn't become the Sanders nomination, what would the headline be?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你要总结一下你认为发生了什么，为什么桑德斯的竞选没能变成桑德斯的提名，标题会是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm not a good headline writer or a headline editor, but I do think clearly there wasn't enough work done with outreach in Southern Black electors in particular.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不是个好的标题撰写人或编辑，但我确实认为，在针对南方黑人选民的联络工作上，显然做得不够。

sentences.en: Senator Sanders was successful in certain elements of Black support.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯参议员在某些黑人支持群体中是成功的。

sentences.en: Young Black people certainly supported him.
sentences.zh: 年轻黑人确实支持他。

sentences.en: But obviously, South Carolina was a huge tipping point for the senator.
sentences.zh: 但显然，南卡罗来纳州对参议员来说是一个巨大的转折点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There was, of course, this consolidation that was very dramatic behind Joe Biden just the weekend before South Carolina, which certainly did a lot.
sentences.zh: 当然，就在南卡罗来纳州初选前的那个周末，乔·拜登身后出现了非常戏剧性的整合，这确实起了很大作用。

sentences.en: But Joe Biden was doing very well in South Carolina the entire time.
sentences.zh: 但乔·拜登在南卡罗来纳州一直表现得非常好。

sentences.en: He has important relationships into our communities.
sentences.zh: 他在我们的社区里拥有重要的关系。

sentences.en: And so that was certainly an important element that should not go unignored.
sentences.zh: 所以这当然是一个不容忽视的重要因素。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You think the campaign should have done a better job with Southern Black voters making the case to them for Sanders for his policies?
sentences.zh: 你认为竞选团队本应在南方黑人选民身上做得更好，向他们阐明桑德斯及其政策的理由吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And also understanding the relational organizing.
sentences.zh: 还有理解那种关系型组织工作。

sentences.en: You know, Senator Sanders did very well with Latino electorates and Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 你知道，桑德斯参议员在拉丁裔选民和拉丁裔群体中表现得非常好。

sentences.en: You know, I think his campaign made a very strong effort to understand us, you know, and it flips, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得他的竞选团队在理解我们方面做出了非常大的努力，你知道，这情况是会反转的，对吧？

sentences.en: Joe Biden did not do well with Latino voters during the primary.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在初选期间在拉丁裔选民中表现并不好。

sentences.en: But Latino voters and Black voters play very different roles.
sentences.zh: 但拉丁裔选民和黑人选民扮演的角色非常不同。

sentences.en: They're two different communities with aligned interests.
sentences.zh: 他们是两个有着共同利益的不同社区。

sentences.en: But, you know, I think that you have to do that outreach to all communities.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我认为你必须对所有社区都进行那种联络。

sentences.en: It's so, you know, I think it comes down to a lot of different things.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我觉得这归结于很多不同的事情。

sentences.en: It sounds like you're saying if Sanders had accomplished with Black voters what he clearly accomplished with Latino voters, this might be a different story.
sentences.zh: 听起来你是说，如果桑德斯在黑人选民身上取得了他在拉丁裔选民身上显然取得的成就，这可能会是另一个故事。

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且不用输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.

sentences.en: So let's talk about the presumptive Democratic nominee who you have not endorsed, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈你尚未背书的民主党假定提名人乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Earlier this week, you spoke to my colleague at The Times,
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，你和我在《时报》的同事，

sentences.en: Estet Herndon, about that.
sentences.zh: Estet Herndon，谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: And at the time, you said that you had never spoken to Joe Biden, which I have to confess was a surprise, and that he had not yet reached out to you.
sentences.zh: 当时你说你从未与乔·拜登交谈过，我必须承认这让我很惊讶，而且他还没有联系过你。

sentences.en: Has that changed?
sentences.zh: 情况有变吗？

sentences.en: Some folks on his team have reached out to us, so our teams are in touch.
sentences.zh: 他团队里的一些人已经联系过我们了，所以我们的团队正在沟通。

sentences.en: But you have not yet spoken to him?
sentences.zh: 但你还没有和他本人交谈过？

sentences.en: No, I have not.
sentences.zh: 没有，我还没有。

sentences.en: There has been this question about how much Joe Biden will absorb the progressive policies that the Bernie Sanders candidacy represented.
sentences.zh: 一直有一个问题，就是乔·拜登会在多大程度上吸收伯尼·桑德斯竞选所代表的进步派政策。

sentences.en: The fact that you have never spoken to Biden and that you as one of the leading members of the progressive movement are not one of the first places he turned
sentences.zh: 事实上你从未与拜登交谈过，而且作为进步运动的领军人物之一，你并不是他首先求助的对象之一，

sentences.en: when Sanders dropped out,
sentences.zh: 当桑德斯退选时，

sentences.en: correct me if I'm wrong, that does not seem to bode especially well for the progressive movement when it comes to that question of, will Joe Biden absorb it?
sentences.zh: 如果我没说错的话，这对于进步运动来说，在乔·拜登是否会吸收这些政策的问题上，似乎并不是什么好兆头，

sentences.en: Do you see it that way?
sentences.zh: 你是这么看的吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I think what's important is that, and what I want to make clear, is that I will be voting for Joe Biden in November.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我认为重要的是，而且我想明确一点，那就是我会在十一月投票给乔·拜登。

sentences.en: I will be supporting him in the general election.
sentences.zh: 我会在大选中支持他。

sentences.en: I think it's really clear that we understand the stakes of November and that we understand how important this is.
sentences.zh: 我认为很清楚的是，我们明白十一月选举的利害关系，也明白这有多重要。

sentences.en: I think sometimes some folks, especially I've seen from different camps are kind of looking at me and they're like, oh, well, who are you?
sentences.zh: 我觉得有时有些人，特别是我看到来自不同阵营的人，他们看着我，就像是，哦，好吧，你是谁？

sentences.en: Like, you're just a freshman congresswoman.
sentences.zh: 就像，你只是个一年级国会议员。

sentences.en: Why is this even important?
sentences.zh: 这为什么重要？

sentences.en: Why is this kind of average important?
sentences.zh: 为什么这种平均水平很重要？

sentences.en: And what I want to make clear is that this is not an ego thing.
sentences.zh: 我想明确的是，这无关自尊心。

sentences.en: I'm not doing this to make us, to pull a stunt or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 我做这些不是为了让我们出风头，或者做类似的事情。

sentences.en: But I think it's very important to make sure that our nominee has plans and is speaking to young people and Latino voters and working class voters.
sentences.zh: 但我认为确保我们的提名人有计划，并且正在与年轻人、拉丁裔选民和工薪阶层选民对话是非常重要的。

sentences.en: And I push not to just score a point, but because I think this is what we need to do to get young people and Latino voters out.
sentences.zh: 我推动这些不是为了得分，而是因为我认为这是我们需要做的，才能让年轻人和拉丁裔选民出来投票。

sentences.en: It's not just about this voting well for progressives.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是为了进步派投票。

sentences.en: It's about us having a goddamn planet to live on in 10 years or in 20 years.
sentences.zh: 这是为了让我们在10年或20年后还有一个该死的星球可以居住。

sentences.en: It's about making sure that babies don't get put in a cage again, to make sure that we end the scourge of mass incarceration.
sentences.zh: 这是为了确保婴儿不再被关进笼子里，确保我们终结大规模监禁的祸害。

sentences.en: The thing that I think is tough sometimes when it comes to this overlap between progressive policies and electoralism is that sometimes the most important communities
sentences.zh: 我认为在进步政策和选举政治之间的这种重叠有时很棘手，因为有时对赢得选举最重要的社区，

sentences.en: for winning an election are not the ones for which progressive policies are most important.
sentences.zh: 并不是那些进步政策最关键的社区。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a very strong emphasis on affluent suburban voters when it comes to winning elections.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在赢得选举时，人们非常强调富裕的郊区选民。

sentences.en: And that's great.
sentences.zh: 那很好。

sentences.en: I understand they are important for winning the election.
sentences.zh: 我明白他们对赢得选举很重要。

sentences.en: They are also a constituency that is uniquely protected from the life and death consequences of a Trump administration and the difference between progressive policy and not.
sentences.zh: 他们也是一个独特的群体，免受特朗普政府带来的生死攸关的影响，也免受进步政策与非进步政策之间差异的影响。

sentences.en: You know, these same affluent suburban white voters are the ones that don't have to worry about their babies in a cage.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些同样的富裕郊区白人选民，是不必担心他们的孩子被关在笼子里的人。

sentences.en: And they may find it uncivil.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会觉得这不文明。

sentences.en: And I think it's, and that's the fundamental tension, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为，这就是根本的张力，对吧？

sentences.en: Is that they are necessary.
sentences.zh: 就是他们是必要的。

sentences.en: They are important.
sentences.zh: 他们很重要。

sentences.en: They are valued.
sentences.zh: 他们是有价值的。

sentences.en: And they are needed to win an election.
sentences.zh: 而且他们是赢得选举所必需的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At the same time, you know, the people that tend to be most impacted by mass incarceration, by unequal access to health care, are sometimes electorates that are taken for granted.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你知道，那些最容易受到大规模监禁、医疗保健获取不平等影响的人，有时是被视为理所当然的选民。

sentences.en: And so that's the issue.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: It's like campaigning is poetry and governance is prose.
sentences.zh: 就像竞选是诗歌，而治理是散文。

sentences.en: Sometimes the poetry, the people you're singing to, and the people that you need to win an election are ones that can be put off by intersectional policy, by talking about ICE
sentences.zh: 有时诗歌，你歌颂的对象，以及你需要赢得选举的人，是那些会被交叉性政策、谈论移民海关执法局（ICE）等事情所疏远的人，

sentences.en: and things like that.
sentences.zh: 以及类似的事情。

sentences.en: And that's just a contradiction we're going to have to live with and try to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们必须共存并试图解决的矛盾。

sentences.en: Well, so help me understand exactly what you're advocating for, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么帮我理解你到底在主张什么，好吗？

sentences.en: Because it sounds like you're acknowledging the challenge for someone like Joe Biden, which is to win moderates and win the general election.
sentences.zh: 因为听起来你承认了像乔·拜登这样的人面临的挑战，那就是赢得温和派并赢得大选。

sentences.en: Embracing progressive policies may actually put off crucial voters.
sentences.zh: 拥抱进步政策实际上可能会疏远关键选民。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about swing voters in Wisconsin, in Michigan, in the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 我在想威斯康星州、密歇根州、中西部的摇摆选民。

sentences.en: So do you or do you not want him to embrace those policies in this moment, knowing that for those suburban voters you just mentioned, who are insulated,
sentences.zh: 所以你到底希不希望他在此时拥抱这些政策，要知道对于你刚才提到的那些受到保护的郊区选民来说，

sentences.en: that might be a major turnoff, might cost him the general election?
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个重大的反感点，可能会让他输掉大选？

sentences.en: Well, again, I think one thing that we can point to is the data that we're seeing and the polling that we're seeing that progressive policies are popular.
sentences.zh: 嗯，再说一次，我认为我们可以指出的一点是我们所看到的数据和民调，进步政策是受欢迎的。

sentences.en: And I think this is when we start kind of digging into this issue of class and race.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是我们开始深入探讨阶级和种族问题的时候。

sentences.en: And I tend to be of the opinion that quote unquote class issues may be issues like Medicare for all and tuition free public colleges and universities and living wages.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于认为所谓的阶级问题可能是像全民医保、免学费公立学院和大学以及生活工资这样的问题。

sentences.en: Those are much more, and a Green New Deal, frankly, which polls very well in those types of communities.
sentences.zh: 那些更……坦白说，还有“绿色新政”，在这些类型的社区里民调非常好。

sentences.en: I think there are other issues that are unpopular with those types of voters, issues like questioning the very structure of ICE and ending mass incarceration.
sentences.zh: 我认为还有其他一些问题在这些类型的选民中不受欢迎，比如质疑ICE的结构和终结大规模监禁的问题。

sentences.en: I do think that one of the things that is compelling about Joe Biden for a lot of voters is just a return to quote unquote normal.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，对于很多选民来说，乔·拜登引人注目的地方之一就是回归所谓的“正常”。

sentences.en: I think it's an uncomfortable reality in politics that a lot of people do vote based on kind of a vibe that they get from a candidate less than just their actual
sentences.zh: 我认为政治中有一个令人不安的现实，那就是很多人投票是基于他们从候选人那里得到的一种感觉，而不是基于他们实际的、

sentences.en: on-the-paper policy commitments.
sentences.zh: 纸面上的政策承诺。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter is is that how a candidate packages themselves can be sometimes to some voters just as important as the actual inside, that the outside does matter.
sentences.zh: 事实是，候选人如何包装自己，有时对某些选民来说，和实际的内在一样重要，外在确实很重要。

sentences.en: And I think the outside that Joe Biden represents is this like a symbolic return to a pre-Trump time, which is very appealing to affluent suburban voters.
sentences.zh: 我认为乔·拜登所代表的外在，是一种象征性的回归到特朗普之前的时代，这对富裕的郊区选民非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: It sounds like you're saying
sentences.zh: 听起来你是说

sentences.en: Biden should choose wisely which progressive policies he embraces in this moment to allow for that return to normal, which sounds like you being more compromising and pragmatic
sentences.zh: 拜登应该明智地选择他在此时拥抱哪些进步政策，以允许那种回归正常，这听起来比我记忆中你过去的声音更妥协、更务实。

sentences.en: than I recall you sounding in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得……我是说，我不知道……我总是得到……

sentences.en: Well, I think that I mean, I don't know about I always get like so
sentences.zh: 我总是觉得这些关于妥协和务实的对话非常奇怪，因为……因为……

sentences.en: I always think these conversations about compromise and pragmatism to be
sentences.zh: 我认为有色人种有时往往是这个国家最务实的人，因为我们必须基于生存做出决定，而且，你知道，工薪阶层，

sentences.en: very strange because because
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是……

sentences.en: people of color I think sometimes have often been the most pragmatic people in this country because we have to make decisions based on survival and, you know, working class people,
sentences.zh: 这是我想要的对决吗？

sentences.en: you know, it's
sentences.zh: 这是我想要的十一月选票吗？

sentences.en: was this the matchup that I wanted?
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Is this a November ballot that I wanted?
sentences.zh: 但我知道，我们的社区至少有一线生机和毫无机会之间是有区别的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为社区往往必须一直做出减少伤害的决定，而不是利益最大化的决定。

sentences.en: But I know that there's a difference between our communities at least having a fighting chance and having no chance.
sentences.zh: 所以乔·拜登和唐纳德·特朗普对你来说是一场减少伤害的竞赛。

sentences.en: You know, I think communities often have to make decisions of harm reduction and not like benefit optimization all the time.
sentences.zh: 这不是理想的竞赛。

sentences.en: So Joe Biden and Donald Trump is a harm reduction contest for you.
